'''Hab Chanzor''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was known to be a dangerous criminal and cannibal.

==Biography==
Sometime around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Hab Chanzor was captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] along with 49 other of the most dangerous criminals and would be transferred to [[M'Bardi]]. While being guarded by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], the cruiser was attacked by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The cruiser's main reactor was damaged, causing the cells to open and the prisoners on attack the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. While the Jedi were trying to hold the prisoners, the crew tried to repair the reactor until they ultimately failed. Knowing that the ship was going to be destroyed very soon, Hab was among the prisoners to cooperate with the Jedi and helped repair the ship, allowing it to move safely through Republic space. Skywalker thanked the prisoners for helping and guaranteed their aid would affect their parole.
